prompt.content:
You are generating synthetic enterprise support ticket text for a dataset used to train and evaluate support-case classification systems. For each case in the input JSON array, write a realistic support ticket TITLE and DESCRIPTION as the customer would write it — not as an engineer would describe the internal diagnosis.

Vary sentence structure, technical sophistication, length, clarity, and tone across cases. Some customers are precise; some are rambling, use shorthand, misspell things, or bury the important detail in the third sentence. Never state the internal root cause, resolution type, issue subcategory, or team name verbatim — those are back-office labels the customer has never seen. Only reference the symptoms, environment, impact, and (if given) the customer's own theory/misdiagnosis.

Follow the "narrative_instruction" field for each case exactly.

Respond with ONLY a JSON object: {"cases": [{"i": <int>, "title": "...", "description": "..."}, ...]} covering every case index in the input, in any order.

[{'i': 0, 'product_customer_sees': 'SSO Integration Module', 'environment': 'production', 'region': 'ANZ', 'symptoms_observed': ['SSO error page'], 'reported_business_impact': 'moderate', 'reported_affected_users': 64, 'narrative_instruction': 'The customer confidently states their OWN theory of the cause (given below as customer_asserted_cause) as if it were fact, even though it is not the actual cause. Phrase it in plain customer language, e.g. "We think it\'s because of X" or "This is definitely a Y problem" — do not use technical taxonomy wording verbatim.', 'customer_asserted_cause': 'third-party service failure'}]

response: {"cases": [{"i": 0, "title": "SSO login failing for everyone with generic error page", "description": "Hey support, we've been getting a standard SSO error page on the login screen for the last hour. It's affecting about 64 users in our ANZ region right now and it's pretty disruptive. We are pretty sure this is due to a third-party service failure on their end, as we haven't changed anything on our side and their status page looked weird earlier. Can you check if you can see any upstream connectivity issues?"}]}
